tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches low behind a wooden bench and peers over the top edge toward a park path, elbows tucked, head tilted curiously to one side.
tasks.camera: eye-level medium shot from the far side of the bench
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands clearly visible gripping the bench back, all fingers distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 从长椅后探头的蓝虎

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side on a gym mat, one leg lifted straight up while the opposite hand reaches to touch the raised foot's yellow sole.
tasks.camera: high three-quarter view looking down at the mat
tasks.visibility_requirement: One hand and one raised sole fully visible with all digits and pad shapes clear.
tasks.intent_zh: 侧卧抬腿触碰脚掌拉伸

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger balances on a narrow wooden fence rail, arms spread wide, one foot in front of the other, gazing down at the grass below.
tasks.camera: low angle from behind the fence looking up
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both outstretched hands visible against the sky.
tasks.intent_zh: 在栅栏上张开双臂保持平衡

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans far over a bridge railing, one hand cupped beside its mouth, calling down toward a river while the other hand grips the rail.
tasks.camera: profile shot from the walkway
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, one cupped at muzzle, one gripping rail.
tasks.intent_zh: 趴在桥栏边朝河里呼喊

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a kitchen counter edge, carefully pressing a cookie cutter into dough with both palms, leaning forward over the rolling pin.
tasks.camera: close front shot across the counter
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands pressed on the cutter, fingers clearly separable.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在厨房台面上用双手压饼干模具

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels on a rocky shore and flips a flat stone with one hand while the other hand steadies against the ground, motion frozen mid-toss.
tasks.camera: low side angle near water level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Throwing hand fingers and supporting hand both clear.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在岸边单手打水漂

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger hangs from a horizontal tree branch with both hands, legs dangling and knees bent, tail curled around the branch for support.
tasks.camera: front medium-low shot against foliage
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both gripping hands visible with fingers wrapped over the branch.
tasks.intent_zh: 双手悬挂在树枝上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crawls forward through a low tunnel of cushions, forearms flat on the ground and head raised, smiling toward the exit.
tasks.camera: low front view framed by cushions
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both forward hands flat and palm-side visible with fingers spread.
tasks.intent_zh: 在垫子隧道里向前爬行

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stands one-legged on a stepping stone, the lifted foot held behind with one hand grasping the ankle, other arm out for balance.
tasks.camera: side full-body shot at pond level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Holding hand, lifted sole with pads, and supporting leg all clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 单脚踩石手抓脚踝平衡

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans back in a desk chair with feet propped on the desk, using a pencil with one hand and holding a notebook with the other.
tasks.camera: three-quarter view from the side of the desk
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible above the desk, pencil grip fingers distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 靠椅背把脚搭在桌上画画

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels to plant a small sapling, one hand steadying the stem and the other scooping loose soil toward the roots.
tasks.camera: low close shot near ground level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible around stem and soil, fingers clearly separated.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪地扶苗另一手捧土

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger steps high over a puddle with knees lifted and one palm forward as if signaling stop, body twisted toward the camera.
tasks.camera: low front angle capturing mid-stride
tasks.visibility_requirement: Raised palm fully visible showing five fingers.
tasks.intent_zh: 抬腿跨水坑并伸手示意

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger pushes a shopping cart up a ramp with both hands on the handle, leaning its weight forward, feet planted plantigrade.
tasks.camera: rear three-quarter view following the cart
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping the cart handle, fingers visible over the bar.
tasks.intent_zh: 双手推购物车上坡

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged on the floor threading a needle, holding it close to one eye with both hands, tongue slightly out in concentration.
tasks.camera: close front shot at floor level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands near the face, pinching fingers clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 盘腿穿针引线

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger climbs a ladder sideways like a crab, one hand and one foot on each rail, glancing back over its shoulder.
tasks.camera: side angle slightly below the ladder
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping rails, fingers wrapped and visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 侧身像螃蟹一样爬梯子

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on the floor and pulls a thick sock onto one foot with both hands, the bare lifted sole facing forward.
tasks.camera: front low shot facing the soles
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on the sock and the raised sole with four toes and pads clearly shown.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐地双手套袜子露出脚掌

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches beside a bookshelf and slides a book back into place with one hand while the other hand holds two more books against its chest.
tasks.camera: side medium shot at shelf height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, pushing fingers and holding fingers clear.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲着把书塞回书架

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger balances a broom upright on one open palm, eyes tracking its sway, the other arm relaxed, feet apart for stability.
tasks.camera: medium wide shot level with the broom
tasks.visibility_requirement: Open balancing palm fully visible with all five fingers flat.
tasks.intent_zh: 单手掌心立扫帚保持平衡

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its stomach at the edge of a dock, one arm reaching down toward the water while both feet kick up behind, soles facing sky.
tasks.camera: low rear angle from the dock
tasks.visibility_requirement: Reaching hand and both upturned soles visible with toes and pads clear.
tasks.intent_zh: 趴在码头边伸手够水双脚翘起

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger ducks under a half-open garage door, twisting sideways with one palm pressed flat on the door bottom and the other near the ground.
tasks.camera: low side view beneath the door
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm pressed flat on the door clearly visible with fingers spread.
tasks.intent_zh: 侧身钻过半开的卷帘门

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a swing and pumps legs forward, gripping both chains, head tipped back laughing toward the sky.
tasks.camera: low front angle looking up
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping swing chains, fingers clearly wrapping the links.
tasks.intent_zh: 荡秋千双手抓链仰头大笑

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels on a bench to tie a friend's shoelace, both hands pulling the loop, face focused downward.
tasks.camera: side close-medium shot at bench height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on the lace loop, pinching fingers distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在长椅上帮人系鞋带

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger does a handstand against a wall, palms flat on the floor and heels resting on the wall, tail hanging straight down.
tasks.camera: side full-body shot near the floor
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both flat palms and both soles with pads clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 靠墙倒立手掌撑地

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger walks a slackline between two posts, one foot centered on the line and arms angled like wings, eyes fixed ahead.
tasks.camera: front long-lens shot along the line
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both balancing arms fully visible against the sky.
tasks.intent_zh: 走扁带专注前方

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches in a garden and aims a garden hose with one hand, the other hand pinching the nozzle tip to spray, water arcing out.
tasks.camera: side angle with water arc in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on the hose and nozzle clearly visible with fingers distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲着捏水管喷水浇园

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its back on a sofa with knees drawn up, holding a game controller with both hands above its face, thumbs on sticks.
tasks.camera: top-down angle over the sofa
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands gripping controller, all fingers and thumbs visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 仰躺沙发举着手柄打游戏

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a low wall and swings both legs over the edge, one palm braced flat beside the hip, looking down at the street.
tasks.camera: side view at wall height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Bracing palm flat and fully visible with fingers spread.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐矮墙边晃腿手掌撑墙

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans out of a train window, one palm flat on the frame and the other shading its eyes, wind ruffling fur.
tasks.camera: exterior side shot beside the window
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible at the window, frame palm and shading palm distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 探出火车窗手搭凉棚

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches at a starting line on a track, fingertips touching the ground, one knee up, waiting for a signal.
tasks.camera: low front three-quarter shot at track level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both planted hands visible with fingertips on the ground.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在起跑线手指触地

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a bed brushing its own tail with a hairbrush, one hand holding the brush and the other gathering the tail tip.
tasks.camera: side close-medium shot at bed height
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands on brush and tail visible with fingers distinct.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在床上给自己尾巴梳毛

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger steps down from a bus, gripping the handrail with one hand while the other hand carries a bag, one foot on the last step.
tasks.camera: low front angle at the bus door
tasks.visibility_requirement: Rail-gripping hand and bag-holding hand both clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 单手抓扶手拎包下公交
